title: Event
description: One Event (CONTEXT.md; PLAN 5 and M19): the front matter of content/events/{id}.md. The text under the front matter is the description, which says what happened and when, supported by the cited sources; it does not evaluate and never says an Event caused a movement. There is no field for a finding, a rating or an effect, and none yet for a measured size: a figure typed in from a published record is a hand-entered value, which needs its Origin on the rights register (ADR 0030, ADR 0033).

id.description: Permanent. The date as written in `date`, then a slug. The file is named for it.

date.description: When it happened, or began: a day, a month or a year, as date_precision says. No day is made up.

end.description: The last day, month or year of an Event that spans time, inclusive, in the precision of `date`. An Event still running has no place here yet: it is recorded when it has ended.

category.description: v1's five, then disaster, infrastructure and legislation (PLAN 5).

status.description: A draft is never in a public-profile Release.

related_series.description: Keys of Series in the Catalog that a reader may want beside this Event. Not a statement that the Event moved them.

accepted_terms.description: Terms of the word list (atlas/content/wordlist.py) that Alex has accepted in this Event's own text, such as a word in the short title of an Act. Never written by `atlas add`.

citation.title: EventCitation
citation.description: Where the Event can be checked: an address and an archived copy of it, or the reason there is none.

no_archive.description: The listed exception: why this citation has no archived copy.
